xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5341: Dock Changes diff view: add the Markdown Preview switch from the conversation diff panel

plan.title: Dock Changes diff view: add the Markdown Preview switch from the conversation diff panel
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The work dock's Changes diff view (DockDiffView.tsx) shows a Markdown file only as diff rows. PAN-5338 gave the conversation diff window a Diff | Preview switch and a reusable preview body (DiffMarkdownPreview, markdownPreviewSource) but left DockDiffView unchanged (its D-13). With the inline diff panel removed by PAN-5295, the dock diff view is the main place to read a conversation's changes, and it cannot render a document.
narratives.Proposal: Reuse PAN-5338's pieces without forking them. A new pure module dock/changes/dockDiffPreview.ts maps a DockDiffTarget onto PAN-5338's PreviewScope (uncommitted -> full with no parsed file, committedVsMain -> vs-main, sha -> compare) and calls markdownPreviewSource, returning null when the target gets no switch (non-Markdown, message body, deleted file). DiffFileBar.tsx exports its tablist as DiffViewSwitch; DockDiffView renders that switch in its tag row and swaps the body for DiffMarkdownPreview when Preview is chosen. The switch state is keyed on path+sha+committedVsMain so stepping to another file returns to Diff. Docs in features/file-explorer.mdx and docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md plus changelog.d/pan-5341.md. See .pan/drafts/PAN-5341.md for exact code.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the conversation diff window's behavior; DiffFileBar only delegates to DiffViewSwitch
- No exact after side for a commit's modified file: it shows the current working-tree file with the note "Showing the current file"
- No Open file button in the dock diff view (Open beside chat already exists)
- No Preview for non-Markdown viewer types (CSV, SVG)
- No persistence of the Diff/Preview choice across targets, sessions or reloads
- No switch while loading, on load errors, or for message states (too large, no folder, edit-workspace committed file, no agent)
- No server change and no new HTTP route
- No second Markdown renderer and no second preview-source rule function
- No change to relative-link behavior inside a patch-source preview (stays inert)

autoDecisions.summary: Map dock target sources onto PAN-5338's markdownPreviewSource (uncommitted->full, committedVsMain->vs-main, sha->compare) instead of writing a new rule
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue forbids a second renderer and the existing function already encodes exactly the three required after-side rules; one rule means the two views cannot drift.

autoDecisions.summary: Uncommitted Preview re-reads the working tree through DiffMarkdownPreview's read source (file passed as undefined) rather than reusing the already-read string
autoDecisions.rationale: A read source passes docLocation so PAN-5337 relative links resolve; the cost is one extra cached readFile on clicking Preview.

autoDecisions.summary: Uncommitted deleted = the working-tree readFile threw NOT_FOUND (new DockDiffBody.files.deleted flag); patch-based deleted = parsed type 'deleted'
autoDecisions.rationale: parseDiffFromFile marks an emptied file as 'deleted' too, so the parsed type cannot tell deleted from emptied for uncommitted files.

autoDecisions.summary: Place the switch in DockDiffView's existing tag row via an extracted DiffViewSwitch, not a third DiffFileBar row
autoDecisions.rationale: DiffFileBar would repeat the path and add an Open file slot the dock already covers; extracting the tablist keeps the markup identical by construction.

autoDecisions.summary: Switch state keyed on path + sha + committedVsMain (the sameTarget identity); default Diff; not persisted
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors PAN-5338 D-4 (choice belongs to one file) and the dock's own target identity in ChangesTab.tsx.

autoDecisions.summary: Extend the existing DockDiffView.test.tsx rather than add a new component test file
autoDecisions.rationale: It is already in scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt and has the mocks needed; only the new pure-helper test needs a subset line.

''}\u0000${target.committedVsMain ? 'main' : ''}`, view (preview only when fileView.key === viewKey), and previewSource = useMemo(() => target && query.isSuccess ? dockMarkdownPreview({ target, body: query.data, rootId }) : null, [...]); (5) make `if (previewSource && view === 'preview') body = <DiffMarkdownPreview source={previewSource} />` the first branch of the body chain; (6) in the tag row, right after the tag span, render {previewSource && <DiffViewSwitch view={view} onView={(v) => setFileView({ key: viewKey, view: v })} />}; (7) add a header-comment sentence naming PAN-5341.
